en: The postcard features a historical European street view with late 19th or early 20th-century architecture. The scene shows large brick houses with ornate facades, gas street lamps, tree-lined boulevards, and people walking or cycling. There is visible text on the card identifying the location as 'Nijmegen' and the street as 'St. Annastraat'. Additional publisher information is printed at the bottom.
